summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullish bets on NVDA and extreme upside/downside hedges on the SPX. Massive accumulation is evident in NVDA 180C and 190C (exp 2026) totaling nearly $600M, alongside aggressive SPX 7000C bets across 2026-2031 expiries. Persistent multi-day conviction is most visible in the SPX 7000C (exp 2026-08-21) and 2026-09-18 strikes, which have seen over $1.7B in accumulation over 4 sessions, paired with massive, persistent SPX 8000P hedging. Traders should watch for extreme volatility or a "volatility squeeze" as the market balances these massive long-dated call bets against the heavy, multi-day accumulation of SPX 8000P tail-risk protection.
